one_month_reasoning: One scheduled event dominates the window: Q3-2026 earnings on Wed Oct 21, 2026 (after close; MarketBeat), with Q4 guidance. Consensus Q3 EPS $2.42 / revenue $5.91B (Yahoo, 24-25 analysts) sits near the top half of TI's $2.23-2.57 / $5.65-6.15B guide, and management has flagged price increases in Q3-Q4, so a beat is likely, but the stock has already run +15% in the past 21 trading days (+4.4% on Oct 2 in a broad semis rally) and the Q4 guide will carry seasonal decline (consensus Q4 EPS $2.28 < Q3). TXN's last eight earnings-day moves were large in both directions (-7.5% Jan-25, -13.3% Jul-25, ~-5.6% Oct-25, +9.9% Jan-26, +19.4% Apr-26, -3.1% Jul-26), i.e. mean absolute ~9%. Peer prints (NXPI, ON, MCHP, ADI-early Nov) also land in or near the window. I see no reliable directional edge (beat-likely vs. stretched after a sharp run-up and high bar), so I center the distribution at today's price (median ~$294) and widen the usual monthly sigma (42%/3.5 = 12%) by ~15% to ~13.8% to reflect the earnings event.

fair_value.method: Blend of NTM P/E (~$10.6 NTM EPS at Oct-2027 x 25x = $265, 50%), FCF yield (~$9.5 FCF/sh at 3.5% = $271, 25%) and EV/EBITDA (CY28 EBITDA ~$14.5B x 17.9x less ~$14.5B pro-forma net debt = $269, 25%); multiples set at the high-quality end of the 11-peer range (ADI 24.9x P/E, 17.9x EV/EBITDA), below TXN's current 29.1x CY27 P/E.

inputs_detail.derivation: 0.25 x CY27 $10.10 + 0.75 x CY28 ~$10.8; CY28 assumes +7% (well below CY27's +19%) because by late 2027 the upcycle will be ~3 years old, the length at which past TXN analog upcycles (2009-10, 2016-18, 2020-22) rolled over, and Portrait Analytics notes part of 2026 auto demand is inventory refill

Peer median CY27 P/E 21.6x (11 peers, range 12.6-41.3x); closest comp ADI 24.9x; TXN's own 5-yr average P/E 26.6x and 2016-2025 annual range 16-36x. 25x = ADI level, inside peer range, modest premium to median justified only by depreciation drag from the 300mm build-out (FCF > net income once capex normalizes, see FCF method), not by growth

inputs_detail.input: H1-2026 operating cash flow / capex / depreciation

inputs_detail.derivation: CY27 revenue $24.9B (consensus) at ~40% OCF margin = ~$10B OCF, less ~$2.5B capex (H1-26 run rate $1.19B x2 plus modest growth), ~$8.5B FCF / ~913M shares = $9.3 in 2027, ~$9.5-10 on a 2028-forward basis; excludes CHIPS ITC receipts as non-recurring

TXN paid out roughly all FCF historically and traded around a 3-4.5% FCF yield in 2015-2021 upcycles; at peer EV/EBITDA medians (~12x) analog peers imply higher yields, so 3.5% is generous rather than conservative

Peer median derived forward EV/EBITDA 12.0x (range 9.0-33.5x); used ADI's 17.9x as TXN's cleanest comp (similar GM, catalog breadth); inside range

bear.story: Upcycle stalls in 2027 as auto/industrial restocking ends (as in 2018-19 and H2-2022), a 2027 US recession (Kalshi ~18%) or China AD duties hit; NTM EPS slips to ~$8.8 and the multiple compresses to ~22x (peer median); SLAB debt adds leverage.

base.story: Recovery continues but decelerates: CY27 EPS ~$10, NTM ~$10.8, multiple drifts from 29x toward ~26x as growth slows; stock roughly flat ex-dividend, consistent with the base rate that after +45% trailing years TXN's median next-12m return is ~+12% with only ~56% positive.

bull.story: Data-center power + pricing + 300mm cost advantage push GM toward the 2022 peak (~70%); NTM EPS ~$12.5 and the market holds ~30x, as in 2017-18 and 2021 when TXN ran a second leg.

comps_summary.peer_range: Calendar-2027 consensus P/E 12.6x (Renesas) to 41.3x (MPWR), median 21.6x; derived CY27 EV/EBITDA 9.0x (STM) to 33.5x (MPWR), median 12.0x. All P/E on one basis: price at 2026-10-02 close / calendar-2027 consensus EPS (off-calendar fiscal years time-weighted: ADI, MCHP, ALGM, IFX). Forward EBITDA is derived (TTM EBITDA + incremental pre-tax earnings implied by CY27 consensus EPS), so EV/EBITDA is approximate and is higher-error for names whose TTM GAAP EPS is depressed vs adjusted consensus.
comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: TXN trades at 29.1x CY27 EPS and ~20.7x derived EV/EBITDA, ~35% above the P/E median and ~70% above the EV/EBITDA median. I apply 25x P/E and 17.9x EV/EBITDA (both = ADI, the closest comp), which sit in the upper half but inside the peer range.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: A modest premium to the median (not to ADI) is supported by one structural, persistent factor: TXN's 300mm build-out leaves depreciation (~$2.2B/yr) well above normalized capex as spending falls (H1-26 capex $1.19B), so FCF should exceed net income through the horizon, which an earnings multiple understates. I do not grant the current 29x because TXN's growth (CY27 EPS +19%) is below the peer median and its cyclicality is similar to peers; the base-rate record shows TXN's multiple compressing as upcycles mature (2018, 2022).

thesis_break_reason: At ~$205 TXN would trade ~20x CY27 consensus EPS or ~23x a cut ~$8.8 EPS, i.e. the market would be pricing the upcycle as over (a 2018/2022-style rollover in auto/industrial orders, a China duty decision or a recession). That is ~30% below today, more than one 12-month sigma move on a typical drift path, and below the pre-April-2026 breakout area, so it would more likely signal fundamental damage than noise.

reasoning: Base rates first: from TXN's monthly history 1990-2025, the unconditional 12-month return has median +17% (p10 -25%, p90 +71%), but after a trailing gain >45% (TXN is +63%) the median next-12m return falls to ~+12% with only 56% of cases positive and p10 -30%; post-2003 episodes (2004-05, 2010-11, 2013, 2016-18, 2021, 2024) split roughly evenly, with 2005, 2011, 2018 and 2021 marking late-cycle tops. ADI shows the same pattern (median +12%, 66% positive). Fundamentals: consensus CY27 EPS $10.10 (+19%) puts TXN at 29.1x vs an 11-peer calendar-2027 median of 21.6x (range 12.6-41.3x); only ADI is a close analog peer and it trades at 24.9x. My blended fair value of ~$268 (P/E 25x on ~$10.6 NTM EPS, FCF yield 3.5% on ~$9.5, EV/EBITDA 17.9x) is ~9% below the price, but upcycles typically keep producing upward estimate revisions for several quarters (Q2 beat consensus EPS by 12%, pricing increases rolling in, lean channel inventory per the Portrait Analytics peer scorecard), and price momentum is strong, so I do not center the distribution on fair value. Netting a ~-9% valuation gap, ~+2% dividend, positive revision momentum and the weak post-run-up base rate gives a median ~$288 (about -2%). Width: realized vol 42% (1y) and 33% (3m); I use ~38% below the median and ~34% above, giving a modest left skew for cycle-rollover risk (bear $195, 25%) against a bull case of $380 (25%). Macro event odds: Kalshi 2027 US recession ~18% (bid/ask 0.18/0.19, ~557k contracts, read 2026-10-04). Research limits: several Yahoo analysis pages failed to render, so peer data came from Yahoo's quoteSummary endpoint; forward EV/EBITDA is derived, not consensus; no option data used.
